title: Executive Director
description:
Lead PNG's front-line fight against corruption and serious fraud
Become a national integrity role model shaping a vital, new institution
Direct critical operations, applying 15+ years of investigative expertise
A Career of Integrity: Join the Papua New Guinea ICAC
The
Independent Commission Against Corruption (ICAC)
, established by the Constitution and the
Organic Law on the ICAC 2020
(
OLICAC
), is the lead agency dedicated to
preventing, reducing, and combating corrupt conduct
across Papua New Guinea. They offer a career of profound national impact, demanding the highest standards of
integrity, professionalism, and courage
. Join the organisation to be an integrity role model and shape the future of a vital national institution.
They are seeking exceptional, experienced professionals to fill this pivotal
Executive Director
role to lead a core operational and strategic division. As a member of ICAC’s senior executive team, you will provide strategic direction and operational oversight to drive the Commission’s mandate.
Lead the ICAC’s Operational Fight on Corruption
Our client is searching for a highly experienced and ethical operational leader for the role of
Executive Director, Investigations, Intelligence & Assessment (IIA) Division
. This role leads the core operational function of the ICAC, directing the assessment of complaints, the collection of intelligence, and the comprehensive
investigation
of corrupt conduct.
Key Responsibilities:
Implement the Commission’s operational objectives using
effective, lawful, and appropriate
strategies.
Oversee the development of processes for complaint assessment, intelligence collection, and corrupt conduct investigation.
Directly supervise the
Directors of Investigations, Intelligence & Assessment
Identify and manage significant operational and organizational
risks
for the Division.
Develop productive working relationships with
key partner agencies
(law enforcement, integrity agencies).
Key Requirements:
Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Law, Criminal Investigations Forensic Accounting or relevant disciplines
Minimum
15 years of work experience
in a law enforcement or investigation body with at least 7
years of experience
at a
senior management level
.
Significant
criminal investigation experience
and expertise, with required
field experience
.
Deep knowledge of criminal law, law enforcement/administrative investigation processes, evidence, intelligence methodologies and public sector systems
Sound judgment in operational matters and well-developed leadership skills.
Apply Now to Make a Difference
If you are a proven operational leader with an unwavering commitment to anti-corruption work, we invite you to apply and direct the ICAC’s most crucial operational front.
Only applicants committed to the highest ethical standards need apply.
Applications close at 5:00 PM, 14th November 2025.
Female candidates are strongly encouraged to apply
